info.name: GuzoMate AI Assistant & Voice Chat API
info.description: Comprehensive Postman Collection for testing GuzoMate's AI Assistant: Text Chat & Voice Chat, PostGIS POI Retrieval (18,833 places in addis_geo_points), Open-Meteo Live Arrival Weather & Clothing Advice, Transit pgvector Knowledge, and Addis AI Multilingual Voice Synthesis.

request.description: Verifies that the GuzoMate backend server and Supabase PostgreSQL + PostGIS database connection are healthy.
Queries 18,833 places in addis_geo_points using PostGIS radius search for verified hospitals near Mercato (e.g. Teklehaimanot, Tikur Anbessa, St. Paul's) with phone and operating hours.
Spatial PostGIS restaurant query in addis_geo_points around Arat Kilo.
Retrieves verified hotel and tourism lodging entries from addis_geo_points in Bole.
Finds commercial banks and ATMs from addis_geo_points.
Semantic retrieval from pgvector rag_documents for Addis Ababa Light Rail Transit (AALRT) and bus routes.
Retrieves road incident notices with mandatory [UNVERIFIED] community report disclosures.

item.name: 1.7 Flexible Relaxation & Leisure (Anywhere in Addis Ababa)

request.description: Flexible query: Assistant suggests top relaxation destinations across Addis Ababa (e.g. Entoto Natural Park, Friendship Park, Unity Park, scenic cafes) even when a specific user location is passed.

item.name: 2.1 Voice Chat - Amharic (መርካቶ ፋርማሲ + የድምጽ መልስ)

request.description: Full Voice Chat turn: User asks in Amharic, system retrieves pharmacies from addis_geo_points, grounds answer, and returns streamable Addis AI (am-hamen) voice audio.

item.name: 2.2 Voice Chat - Destination Arrival Weather + Clothing & Umbrella Advice

request.description: Voice Chat with Live Weather Forecast: Evaluates weather around arrival time, provides clothing/umbrella suggestions, and speaks the response in English via Addis AI.

item.name: 2.3 Voice Chat - Afaan Oromo (Bole Pharmacy + Sagalee)

request.description: Voice Chat in Afaan Oromo: Auto-detects language, finds pharmacies near Bole, and generates spoken Afaan Oromo audio using Addis AI (om-bikila).
Direct speech synthesis returning streamable MP3 audio URL and duration.
Afaan Oromo TTS generation using Addis AI Voices 2.
English TTS generation using Addis AI Voices 2.

item.name: 4.1 Multi-Turn Turn 1: State Preference (Saved to Persistent Session)

request.description: Establishes user context stored in the single persistent session for user 'traveler_dan'. Stored indefinitely in assistant_messages table.

item.name: 4.2 Multi-Turn Turn 2: Follow-up Query Relying on Memory

request.description: Demonstrates multi-turn memory recall: Assistant uses conversation history to remember user's Italian food preference.

item.name: 4.3 Natural Language Memory Erase (English: 'erase your memory')

request.description: Natural language memory erase command. Assistant intercepts the query, purges assistant_messages for 'traveler_dan', and returns a fresh-start confirmation.
Multilingual natural language memory wipe in Amharic ('ትዝታህን አጥፋ'). Wipes session and confirms in Amharic.
Direct REST API endpoint to clear persistent conversation memory for a user.

item.name: 4.6 Explicit Memory Clear Endpoint (DELETE with x-user-id header)

request.description: RESTful DELETE endpoint to clear memory using the x-user-id header.
